title: CE60002: Advanced Computational Hydraulics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Ordinary and partial differential equations; finite difference schemes implicit and explicit types; accuracy, convergence and stability; method of
characteristics; finite element method - variational and weighted residual
formulations; applications to steady and unsteady flows; pollutant dispersion;
flood wave propagation; tidal model; applications with computer programming.
